data.name: GigaTroubleS
data.detailed_description:
Embark on a unique journey of exploration and puzzle-solving centered around the "Giant Girl" theme. A fusion of deep narrative and diverse gameplay awaits.

You are a struggling young writer. After a series of crushing setbacks, an accident leaves you with dissociative amnesia. You wake up in a room that feels entirely alien, clutching at the void where your memories used to be...

Now, you must navigate a surreal reality to reclaim your past.

    Three Independent Character Storylines

Experience three distinct storylines, each featuring a unique "Giantess Girl" archetype with its own emotional arc and gameplays:

Size Difference : What is going on with this unfamiliar room? Why has the world at night become... become so... strange? Still, this would let you try using your size advantage after dark to uncover the secrets hidden behind all this... However, the small girl you see by day may turn into your “giantess” obstacle.

  • Be careful.

    Schbatruien StoryLine

    1, Search for clues and answers across dozens of wondrous, even bizarre, scenes. It might be nothing more than an ordinary room, or it might be an entirely unfamiliar environment you face at night after being shrunk, with countless puzzles waiting to be solved.

    2, Even cute Schbatruien you see by daytime can become an excellent place to explore in nighttime. Perhaps she will try to eat you as a snack? Or maybe, while she is not paying attention, you can look for secrets hidden on her body?

    3, Can you have a real talk to her? She seems so spaced-out that she hardly says anything worth mentioning, but if she is in a good mood, maybe she will still reveal some useful clues.

    4, Three different minigames with size-difference gameplay, just because Schbatruien wants to have some fun with you.....

So, who exactly is she? What really happened in your childhood?

Maybe a little more exploring will lead to an answer.

  • ————————————————————————————————————————————————————————

    Gradual Growth: Before the planet is consumed by her body, establish a foothold aboard the ship that will carry humanity to settle on another world. But what is this ship, exactly? ...Wait, would she be willing to become a colony ship?!

    Transformative Gigantism : Aid the person you trust most in restoring her full potential during the autumn of an empire’s decline, and in reviving the glory of the grand duchy... No line infantry can withstand her red high heels!

    (Still in the plan)

    ____________________________________________________________________________

    These paths can be enjoyed independently or woven together to piece together your past, present... and future.

    Diverse Gameplay & Mini-games

    From intricate environmental puzzles to intense real-time combat, the variety is boundless. Every path offers a new experience: engage in "size-difference" mini-games, act as her support in battle, or even... build a colony within her body?

    Intertwined Dual-Layer Narrative

    Are you truly just a "failed writer"? A Goddess reveals a grander mission—a chance to atone for a catastrophic mistake from your past. Follow the "Key Clue" that connects the surface plot with the hidden truth. As you recover memory fragments, you’ll discover how they echo darker events lurking beneath the surface.

    Multi-Ending & Meta-Progression

    Destiny is not set in stone. Your choices, discoveries, and the memories you choose to believe will lead to various endings for each heroine and a grand "True Memory" finale. Every playthrough uncovers new emotional impacts and hidden details.

    Collect and Reflect

    Discover a wealth of Easter eggs, hidden dialogues, and collectibles. Read the lore behind every item to reconstruct the full picture of your history. But beware: do not be blinded by falsehoods.

    Dynamic Puzzle Solving

    Dozens of puzzles integrated into the environment and story logic will test your wits. Trust your judgment as you step closer to the truth.

But remember... are the memories you’ve recovered actually real? Believe in yourself. Or don't.

data.short_description: Собери воедино полную историю в этой уникальной приключенческой игре с девушками-гигантессами, сочетающей исследование от первого лица и разгадывание тайн, текстовое приключение, roguelike, бой в реальном времени и множество интересных механик!
data.supported_languages:
English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese*, Traditional Chinese, Russian
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11（64-bit）
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 and above
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 10 and above
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11（64-bit）
  • Processor: Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 and above
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
